policy: Hook-only plain descriptions of journal quests, shown to a companion only while the quest is in V's journal. Each states what V knows when the job first appears (who asks, what is asked, where), from the earliest revealed journal description and first objectives, with the reviewed catalog synopsis used only to identify the hook. No outcomes, twists, deaths, choices or later stages. Written 2026-10-09 in six review lanes and spot-checked; endings, epilogues and meta quests with no safe hook are excluded and fall back to the journal title.
